description_en: A low footstool with a gently sloping woven deck and a removable fabric cushion on a wide trestle base; the front shows the broad cushion edge, the side shows the shallow ergonomic slope, and the rear reveals two trestles joined by a bamboo stretcher. Show this single complete furniture object alone on a plain studio background. All surfaces, hardware and panels must be unmarked, with no letters, numbers, logos, labels, captions or watermarks.
